title: When you turn to explore your path to victory clearly lessons every loss taught sought the finish line more than anything you did this time #poetrypor
summary: When you turn to explore your path to victory clearly lessons every loss taught sought the finish line more than anything you did this time #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
When you turn to explore
your path
to victory
clearly lessons every loss
taught sought
the finish line
more than anything
you did this time
#poetryport
